name: pattern-cover
title: Pattern cover
description: A designed placeholder for missing artwork: a monochrome pattern drawn from any string, the same on server and client, square or round, in theme tokens.
docs: seed is any string (a playlist name, a project id): the same seed always draws the same cover. The seed picks one of five families (rings, stripes, a Bauhaus grid, Truchet arcs, a halftone), the layout and whether the cover is light or dark. It is SVG in foreground and muted tokens, with no random numbers, no images and no network. shape is square or round, size a number of px or any CSS length. It is decoration (aria-hidden) unless you give it a label.
